changes.what: On the sweep date the Division of Collections & Infrastructure listed Collections Stewardship, Rediscovering Our Revolutionary Tradition, Celebrate America! Chairman's [Grants](#term:grant), Endowments for Advancing the Humanities, the National Digital Newspaper Program and Save America's Treasures; Humanities Collections and Reference Resources, Research and Development, and Digital Humanities Advancement Grants were not listed, though their pages remained online without dates [645](#cite:645) [639](#cite:639) [640](#cite:640) [637](#cite:637).

On the sweep date the [NEA](#term:nea) Assurance of Compliance required applicants to certify, citing [Executive Order](#term:executive-order) 14173, that they operate no DEI programmes that violate applicable federal anti-discrimination laws [656](#cite:656).

The [NEA](#term:nea) [grants](#term:grant) page states that Grants for Arts Projects deadlines have passed, that new guidelines are anticipated by late December 2026, and that Challenge America and Our Town are now part of the Grants for Arts Projects application process [653](#cite:653) [654](#cite:654).

[NEH](#term:neh)'s programme pages give the next cycle for its four individual awards as opening January 15, 2027 and closing April 14, 2027, with notification January 31, 2028; the 2026 Fellowships deadline was April 22, 2026 [986](#cite:986) [1003](#cite:1003) [1004](#cite:1004) [1005](#cite:1005) [988](#cite:988).

On the sweep date the [NEA](#term:nea)'s [grants](#term:grant) page listed six categories and neither Creative Writing Fellowships nor Translation Projects; both programme pages still carried FY 2026 guidelines with 2025 deadlines [653](#cite:653) [1006](#cite:1006) [1008](#cite:1008).
